methodology_note: Route induction through execute_bounded_llm_reinduction (min_heldout_accuracy=1.0, candidate_provider = the loaded engine, load_engine + plan_in_model from arc_executable_world_model) via exp5760.run_cegis_cell VERBATIM -- the ONLY scientific variable vs REQ-ARC-WMTE-5760 is the generator (gemma-4-31B-it dense, /v1/chat/completions with its embedded chat template, vs ThinkingCap-27B/Qwen-9B). Per-round heldout from outcome.rounds[*]['heldout_accuracy'] (exact-match on the held-out split; CARNOT_ARC_TRUST_METRIC forced OFF so the metric is exact, not cell_recall). round 0 = induce (the within-run single-shot baseline), rounds 1-2 = refactor. Proposer mirrors tonight's reason-induce (codeonly OFF, /think, tries=1, 16384 budget). gemma pinned to GPU 1 (CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1), own llama-server on port 8972, PARALLEL to and NON-INTERFERING with the GPU-0 CEGIS job (which stays on GPU 0 via CARNOT_5726_QW_CUDA=0). n_ctx chosen by a launch-time ladder (32768 first for comparability; smaller only on OOM). Disclosed divergences (identical to 5764/5760): (1) the '/think\n' prefix is a Qwen-ism gemma ignores; (2) round 0 uses the loop's STANDARD induce (the live path), not tonight's _induce_no_fence variant -- but the rigorous quantity is the INTERNAL round-0-vs-refined delta. A DIAGNOSTIC over the EXISTING live refinement mechanism with a bigger offline model, NOT a live-path modification and NOT an orphan solver.

Those cells are not measurements. Owned separately -- the fix changes what min_heldout_accuracy admits on the LIVE trust gate and is out of scope for this change.

finding_3_the_measurement_is_defective_i.statement: Even had the antecedent been met, the primary metric could not have supported a retirement. The experiment contains ZERO cells in which an engine that fit its own evidence was carried intact into a refinement round and then graded. Every such engine was destroyed by the refactor write path before the gate could measure whether feedback helps.

evidence_from_this_artifacts_own_shard.note_on_19_of_19: Not one engine that fit what it was shown survived a refactor round; 8 of them went from a PERFECT prefix fit of 1.0 to 0.0. prefix_accuracy was recorded on every round record of this artifact and was never read by the analysis that produced the verdict.

composition_of_the_13_cell_primary_metri.note: The 11 zero-minus-zero cells cannot distinguish 'refinement does not help' from 'there was nothing to refine'. The 2 informative cells (sb26 -0.444444, tu93 -0.333333) both had a working round 0 that collapsed to exactly 0.0 -- i.e. they measure the write-path defect, not the hypothesis.

structurally_unfalsifiable_games.mechanism: WorldModelVerifier.score (python/carnot/agentic/arc_executable_world_model.py:1780-1785) excludes level-up rows and returns n_correct / max(1, n). The induction window is cut to END at the level-up transition, so that row is always last and always lands in the held-out tail. Where the tail is one row, n == 0 and the metric returns 0.0 for EVERY engine, including a perfect oracle.
structurally_unfalsifiable_games.in_repo_corroboration: The project already diagnosed and fixed this exact failure in the SIBLING function score_goal_predicate_consistency (same file, ~lines 2298-2317), whose comment reads: 'NOTHING GRADEABLE MUST NOT READ AS MAXIMALLY INCONSISTENT ... the veto would fire HARDEST exactly when it has no evidence'. That fix returns 1.0 for an all-excluded window and exposes n == 0 as the discriminator. WorldModelVerifier.score never received it. The project's own reasoning, in its own code, condemns the metric this gate used.
structurally_unfalsifiable_games.oracle_control_non_vacuous: Checked in results/experiment_5766_round0_regression_reproduction.json: the oracle reaches 1.0 on full windows, so its 0.0 on these four tails is informative, not a broken probe.

finding_3_the_measurement_is_defective_i.metric_resolution: Held-out tails carry 0-3 gradeable rows, so a per-cell delta moves only in steps of 1/n (0.333 at best), while the pre-registered gate is written in units of 0.15 and 0.05. No engine change can move a 3-row tail by 0.05. A pooled delta near zero is substantially a statement about metric resolution.

disposition.reasoning: There is nothing to lift: the clause's own precondition was never met, so no retirement was ever created by this artifact. Recording that plainly is the correction. Separately, and independently of the antecedent, the measurement the clause would have rested on is defective in three named ways, so a FUTURE run of this harness that did reach HONEST-NEGATIVE would also not be interpretable until the refactor write path, the acceptance/refinement split, and the ungradeable-tail metric are fixed.
disposition.what_is_NOT_claimed: This does not make the hypothesis true. Refinement improved 0 of 39 cells, and two independent priors (exp4872 Failed, exp5760 Research Finding) point the same way. A broken instrument is not evidence FOR the thing it failed to measure. The honest state is UNMEASURED, not positive.
disposition.nothing_deleted: preregistration.retire_if_same_verdict is preserved verbatim and unedited, as is corrigendum_2026_08_03_cross_experiment_comparison_voided and every other pre-existing field. This key is additive.

That block is appropriate and should be cleared through the documented mechanism, not bypassed.

ready_to_use_prior_failures_entry.addressed_by: The prior run did not test the hypothesis: the refactor write path overwrote each engine wholesale from a prompt containing neither the engine nor its passing cases, collapsing 19 of 19 fitted engines to prefix 0.0; acceptance was graded on rows that also fed refinement; and 4 of 13 games had a structurally ungradeable held-out tail scoring 0.0 for any engine including a perfect oracle. A rerun is warranted only once those three are fixed AND a positive control shows a nonzero delta is reachable.

guidance_for_a_future_planner_or_operato.an_open_adjacent_lever_that_is_NOT_retir: ops/exclusion_manifest.yaml retires RAISING THE TOKEN BUDGET as an induction-quality remedy (id outer_loop_arc_induce_budget_phase1_20260731, operator_reopen_required). Degenerate engines that never change the grid are a decode-level repetition problem. Any rerun should carry that sampler change; a budget raise is retired.
